title: I Seek You in Videos: Identity-Conditioned Queries for Person-Centric Video Reasoning
abstract: Real-world video reasoning often involves multimodal, multi-source inputs, whereas existing video reasoning tasks typically assume a simplified video-text setting, limiting identity matching and person-centric reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Identity-conditioned Queries (ICQ) task, in which models are required to jointly associate and interpret an input video and a reference image of a person, and leverage this conditioning to address identity grounding, behavior understanding, and temporal reasoning, among other challenges. Building on ICQ, we present ISYV (I Seek You in Videos), a systematic solution comprising three components: (1) ISYV-Bench, a challenging evaluation benchmark with 1,377 real-world complex videos and 1,377 question-answer pairs, organized into six difficulty levels spanning capabilities from identity recognition to causal reasoning; (2) ISYV-75K, a large-scale training set of 75K high-quality samples constructed via automated annotation, multi-stage verification, and manual review; and (3) ISYV-Framework, containing an ICQ-oriented model and training strategy for learning to exploit informative video shots without additional shot-level annotations. Extensive experiments show that both mainstream closed-source and open-source MLLMs struggle on ISYV-Bench, especially in cross-domain identity matching and long-horizon tracking. ISYV-Model outperforms strong baselines and in some aspects approaches closed-source performance. Overall, ISYV provides a unified task definition, scalable datasets/benchmarks, and modeling insights for person-centric video reasoning.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 ACM Multimedia 2026 对应的 arXiv 2608.07417v1 全文整理；PDF 未提供可核实的代码仓库 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: 给 video reasoning 增加人物 reference image 作为 identity condition，用 learnable queries 压缩身份特征，再通过 SFT 与带 Effective Shot Reward 的 GRPO 学会选择支撑答案的镜头。
methodFlow: 输入 reference-person image、video frames 与 question
ICQ tokens 先 self-attend，再 cross-attend reference-image features
把压缩 identity queries 与 video/text tokens 一同输入 MLLM
用 SFT 学 reference description、candidate shots 与 answer format
以 GRPO 优化 answer/caption rewards，并用 ESR 选择有效镜头
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它属于 VLM/MLLM 与 video understanding 的交叉，identity-conditioned query 和 shot-selection reward 对多源视觉 agent 有方法价值；但任务聚焦人物追踪与影视理解，与用户核心 2D/3D design generation 不是直接主线。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 ISYV overall 为 57.01%，human 为 95.13%、Gemini-2.5-Pro 为 67.10%、base Qwen2.5-VL-7B image setting 为 24.76%（Table 3, p. 7）。但使用相同 RFT setup、保持普通 Qwen architecture 的 baseline 已达 54.22%，ICQ 的净差为 2.79 points。SFT 为 33.75%，加入 format+accuracy、caption 与 ESR 后依次达到 52.06%、55.44% 与 57.01%（Table 4, p. 8）。
analysis.caveatZh: ISYV-75K 大量由 MLLMs 自动生成与复核，可能继承 teacher bias；film、TV 与 anime 数据的 licensing 和 identity privacy 也不够清楚。benchmark videos 平均约 50 秒、每视频仅一个 QA，不能代表 long-form memory；作者报告 social reasoning 为 37.22%，仍远低于 Gemini 的 80.56%。
analysis.motivationZh: 一般 video QA 只接收 video 与 text，不能表达“针对 reference image 中这个人”进行跨镜头身份匹配、行为理解与因果推理的现实多源查询。
analysis.methodZh: ISYV-Bench 将 identity、behavior、temporal、social、shot memory 与 causal reasoning 分成六级任务。ICQ module 用 32 个 learnable queries cross-attend reference image features，再与 video/text tokens 一起进入 Qwen2.5-VL-7B；训练先 SFT 学结构化轨迹，再用 answer、caption 和 Effective Shot Reward 做 GRPO。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者报告 benchmark 含 1,377 videos/QA pairs，训练集实际含 24,150 videos 与 74,578 QA pairs，标准测试采样 32 frames。比较覆盖 humans、open/closed MLLMs、text/image references 与同 recipe baseline，并对 rewards、query-token count 和 frame count 做 ablation；仍缺跨 backbone、长视频、多人物 scaling 与 synthetic-teacher holdout。
analysis.insightZh: person-centric video reasoning 的主要提升来自 data 与 post-training，identity-query architecture 提供的是较小但可解释的增益；评估这类模块时，应把相对 raw base 的大幅提升拆成 training recipe 与 architecture 的净贡献。
